name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, joined Awin Feeds, and approved eBay listings; find verified deals and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.10.5 keeps all user-facing prose in the request language: English requests receive English responses and Chinese requests receive Chinese responses, while product names, brands, and models remain unchanged. Exact-product requests remain separate from category discovery: named-product identity anchors are preserved, conflicting apparel types are rejected, unrelated products never pad the top three, and alternatives appear only when explicitly requested. Ranking prioritizes identity, specification fit, merchant quality, availability, verified deals, and price. Awin Feed, Shopify Global Catalog, and approved opt-in eBay listings remain read-only sources. Node.js 24, stable product selection, fail-closed schema handling, neutral affiliate ranking, and bounded authorized Chrome fallback remain in place. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
